title: Introduce proportional SLO multiplexer + transparent rejoin hotfix
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Hotfix: add proportional SLO multiplexer to reduce circuit oscillation and transparent rejoin path to gradually restore tenants after regional failovers. Backwards-compatible. No config migration required.
description: Motivation: During a recent regional failover incident multiple high-throughput tenants repeatedly tripped their local circuits which caused aggressive global fallbacks and long tail recovery for low-rate tenants. The root cause was a binary routing decision in the SLO enforcer + fallback allocator: when a tenant exceeded its SLO bucket the system would immediately move 100% of requests to slowpath fallbacks which amplified upstream load and caused oscillation. This PR introduces a proportional SLO multiplexer that divides degraded traffic across fallback tiers in configurable proportions (fastfall, slowfall, degraded) and a transparent rejoin path that warms restored capacity with probe-driven ramping rather than abrupt reinstates. The changes are intended as a hotfix to stabilize production while preserving request-level SLAs.
commits:
1) add proportional multiplexer and configuration schema (slo/multiplexer.go + slo/config.go)
2) implement transparent rejoin probes and state machine (slo/rejoin.go)
3) integrate multiplexer into router and egress proxy (router/mux_integration.go, proxy/egress_shim.go)
4) add unit and integration tests + loadbench scenario (slo/multiplexer_test.go, perf/loadbench/proportional_slo.json)
5) update observability: new metrics and dashboard panels (telemetry/metrics.go, dashboards/proportional_slo.json)
6) small docs note and upgrade guidance (docs/release-notes/proportional-slo.md)
review_comments: Ethan Cole: Nice approach, Priya. Can you clarify how the proportions are derived when multiple tenants are in partial degrade? Concerned about head-of-line inversion. Please add a short note in slo/config.go with the formula and a unit test for the multi-tenant case.
Priya Nair (author): Added explicit formula comments and a multi-tenant unit test (slo/multiplexer_test.go). Also added a deterministic tie-breaker by tenant ID hash to avoid HOI.
Marisol Vega: Observability looks good but we need an alert for rejoin flapping (more than 3 rejoin failures in 10m). Can you wire that up to the SLO team alerting rule?
Priya Nair: Added telemetry metric slo_rejoin_failures and a corresponding alert rule draft in telemetry/alerts.yml. Marked alert as a candidate for 2-hour paging after we validate in staging.
Diego Chen: CI caught a race in egress_shim with pointer reuse; please ensure the pool copy is defensive.
Priya Nair: Fixed pool copy and added stress test that reproduces the race locally.
ci_log_summary: Initial CI run: failed unit test (race in proxy/egress_shim.go) -> author pushed fix -> rerun pipeline -> all checks passed (unit tests, integration tests, staticcheck, go-race on key packages, loadbench sanity run). Loadbench nightly showed stable tail latencies under synthetic spike scenario.
incident_context: This change was developed as a hotfix in response to incident INT-2026-02-11 where three regions experienced repeated tenant oscillation after a peering event. The multiplexer reduces the blast radius by proportionally shifting traffic rather than binary fallback. Linked incident: INT-2026-02-11-RegionFailover.
